sources.name: PowerPyx
sources.note: Full guide + roadmap; the missable call on Positive Mental Attitude.
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

sources.name: Official list (kit)
sources.note: Starter kit list; names, descriptions and grades verbatim.
sources.title: The official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18

trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 are done — there is no separate task. Plan the run around the one missable in Stop 1, then work the stops in order; the final pop is A Long Road's gold followed immediately by this one.
trophies.how: Earn the other 54 trophies; this one follows on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies — this one pops on its own the moment the last one lands.
Keep the Stop 1 save habit: one manual save at the start of every chapter, plus one before the final mission.
Finish with A Long Road (100% completion) in Stop 7 — the checklist threshold is forgiving, about 60% true completion.

trophies.where: Everywhere — it pops when the other 54 are done.

trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, is unmissable — play through the start of the story and it pops when the mission ends. It is the first of the twelve story trophies, and the reason the Keys region opens at 3/5 in this guide's demo progress.
trophies.how: Play the opening mission to its end; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.t: Start a new game and play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end.
No special objective is needed — finishing the mission is the whole requirement.
It pops at the mission-complete screen; if it does not, the mission was not finished.

trophies.where: Leonida Keys — the opening mission, Gone Fishing.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The chapter closes after the opening missions, and the trophy marks the end of the first act — including the early meditation spot that must not be skipped (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.how: Finish every Chapter 1 mission; meditate at the early spot first.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.t: Play through every Chapter 1 mission in order.
Meditate at the early Chapter 1 spot before the chapter closes — it is gone for good afterwards.
The trophy pops when the chapter-complete screen appears.

trophies.where: Leonida Keys — the end of Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. By now Jason and Lucia are both playable, which is when most of the map's trophies start to open up — side content picked up here counts toward later stops.
trophies.how: Finish every Chapter 2 mission; both protagonists are playable now.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.t: Play through every Chapter 2 mission.
Try side activities as they appear — both protagonists being playable unlocks most of them.
The trophy pops at the end of the chapter.

trophies.where: Leonida Keys — the end of Chapter 2.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Heists open up in Chapters 3–4, and the Strangers & Freaks strand tied to the race against Yago starts closing mid-story here — start every stranger strand the moment it appears.
trophies.how: Finish every Chapter 3 mission; start stranger strands at once.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.t: Play through every Chapter 3 mission.
Start the Strangers & Freaks strands as soon as they appear — one closes in this chapter.
The trophy pops at the end of the chapter.

trophies.where: Port Gellhorn — the end of Chapter 3.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. This is the last full chapter before the finale — use the chapter-start manual save, because there is no mission replay to fall back on.
trophies.how: Finish every Chapter 4 mission; keep a chapter-start save.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.t: Play through every Chapter 4 mission.
Make a manual save at the start of the chapter; there is no mission replay.
The trophy pops at the end of the chapter.

trophies.where: Port Gellhorn — the end of Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Make a manual save before it — once the credits roll, free roam continues, but the finale itself cannot be replayed.
trophies.how: Save manually first, then finish the final mission.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.t: Make a manual save before starting the final mission.
Play the final mission to its end.
After the credits, free roam stays open for every cleanup stop.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. It is one of the six named story missions with its own trophy — all of them are unmissable as long as the mission itself is played.
trophies.how: Finish the mission Breakfast Run; no optional objective needed.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.t: Reach the mission Breakfast Run in the story.
Play it to completion — the trophy is tied to finishing the mission, not to any optional objective.
It pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.where: Vice City — the mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. Like the other named story missions it is unmissable — the trophy is the mission, and the mission is mandatory.
trophies.how: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.t: Reach the mission The Cartel Heist in the story.
Play it to completion — finishing the mission is the whole requirement.
It pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.where: Port Gellhorn — the mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. A named story mission with its own trophy — play it through and the trophy follows.
trophies.how: Finish the mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.t: Reach the mission Child's Play in the story.
Play it to completion — finishing the mission is the whole requirement.
It pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.where: Mount Kalaga — the mission Child's Play.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. Another named story mission — mandatory in the story, so its trophy cannot be missed by skipping side content.
trophies.how: Finish the mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.t: Reach the mission Headliners in the story.
Play it to completion — finishing the mission is the whole requirement.
It pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. The airport mission — it also introduces the VCIA area that the Catch Me If You Can trophy later uses.
trophies.how: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.t: Reach the mission VCIA Takedown in the story.
Play it to completion — finishing the mission is the whole requirement.
It pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.where: Port Gellhorn — the mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the six named story-mission trophies — after it, only the chapter trophies and the finale remain in Stop 1.
trophies.how: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.t: Reach the mission Operation Savage Glory in the story.
Play it to completion — finishing the mission is the whole requirement.
It pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.where: Ambrosia — the mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, visible after the story). The threshold is forgiving — about 60% true completion is enough: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges. What must be full: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. The checklist splits roughly 45% story & tasks, 45% exploration & activities, 10% discovery.
trophies.how: Work the 100% checklist after the story; the thresholds are forgiving.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.t: Finish the story first — the 100% checklist only appears after it, though progress during the story still counts.
Do the optional missions when they appear: they feed the checklist and close as the story advances, while the checklist itself stays forgiving.
Clear the must-be-full sets — robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races, Bret's quests — then mop up the forgiving counts.

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, air time and clean landings anywhere in Leonida. Find one jump with a safe landing zone and repeat it in free roam after the story; the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road too.
trophies.how: Repeat one safe jump in free roam; air time + clean landing counts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.t: Find a jump or ramp with a clean landing zone and repeat it in free roam after the story.
Land 250 stunts — air time and a clean landing both count toward the total.
Keep going to 300 stunts if you are chasing A Long Road, which wants more than the trophy does.

trophies.where: Statewide — anywhere with jumps, ramps and air.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once. The activities are the ones Stop 3 is built around — shooting range, drone races, races, fishing, arcade, bowling and the rest. One try each is enough; no score or win is needed.
trophies.how: Try each of the 9 activity types once — no win needed.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.t: Open the activities list and work through the 9 types one by one.
One try each is enough — the trophy counts attempts, not wins.
The last untried type pops the trophy; check the counter if one type will not register.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the hardest pure-skill trophy in Stop 3 — practice one range at a time and learn its target pattern before chasing gold; the ranges are also one of the must-be-full sets for A Long Road.
trophies.how: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, one range at a time.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.t: Visit a Shooting Range and learn its challenge pattern before chasing gold.
Gold each of the 42 challenges — the ranges are also a must-be-full set for A Long Road.
The trophy pops when the 42nd gold medal lands.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are one of the must-be-full sets for the 100% checklist, so a win at every location does double duty.
trophies.how: Win a drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.t: Find a Top Fun drone race location and learn its course.
Win a race at each of the 14 locations — wins, not just finishes, count.
Drone races are a must-be-full set for A Long Road, so every win counts twice.

trophies.where: Vice City — Top Fun drone race locations.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word — twenty wins on the same track count once. Work through the race list across Leonida and tick each new track off as you win it.
trophies.how: Win 20 different races — repeats on one track count once.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.t: Open the race list and pick a track you have not won yet.
Win it, then move to the next new track — 20 different wins are needed.
The trophy pops on the 20th different race win.

trophies.where: Vice City — race tracks across Leonida.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal's challenge is part of the side-story cleanup in Stop 2 — take it when it appears and fish it out rather than leaving it for later.
trophies.how: Take Cal's fishing challenge when it appears and beat him.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.t: Find Cal's fishing challenge in the side-story strands.
Fish the challenge through and beat Cal's score.
The trophy pops when the challenge ends in your favour.

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Any arcade game counts — pick the one you are best at, play it through to its end, and the trophy is yours. It also ticks one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.how: Play any arcade game through to its end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.t: Find an arcade and pick a game you are comfortable with.
Play it through to its end — a finished game is what counts.
It also ticks one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Each contact has a final mission with its own trophy — play Andy's strand through to its end in Stop 2. Side-story content stays available after the story, so there is no deadline, but finishing strands as they appear keeps the cleanup short.
trophies.how: Play Andy's strand through to its final mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.t: Start Andy's strand when it appears and follow it through.
Play each mission in the strand in order.
The trophy pops when Andy's final mission ends.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Kenton's strand ends with its own trophy, like every contact strand in Stop 2 — follow it to the end and the trophy follows.
trophies.how: Play Kenton's strand through to its final mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.t: Start Kenton's strand when it appears and follow it through.
Play each mission in the strand in order.
The trophy pops when Kenton's final mission ends.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Billy's strand is one of the six contact strands in Stop 2 — play it through to its final mission.
trophies.how: Play Billy's strand through to its final mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.t: Start Billy's strand when it appears and follow it through.
Play each mission in the strand in order.
The trophy pops when Billy's final mission ends.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish all 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. This is time-sensitive: the strand tied to the race against Yago closes mid-story in Chapter 3, so start every stranger strand the moment it appears and do not stockpile them for later. The other strands stay open, but the Yago one does not wait.
trophies.how: Start every stranger strand the moment it appears — the Yago race closes in Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.t: Start every stranger strand the moment it appears — do not leave them for post-story cleanup.
Do the race against Yago in Chapter 3 before it closes; it is the strand with a deadline.
Finish all 8 strands; the trophy pops when the eighth ends.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Randy's strand is one of the six contact strands in Stop 2 — follow it to its final mission.
trophies.how: Play Randy's strand through to its final mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.t: Start Randy's strand when it appears and follow it through.
Play each mission in the strand in order.
The trophy pops when Randy's final mission ends.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Tyrone's strand closes out like the other contact strands — play it through to the end.
trophies.how: Play Tyrone's strand through to its final mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.t: Start Tyrone's strand when it appears and follow it through.
Play each mission in the strand in order.
The trophy pops when Tyrone's final mission ends.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — and do it the moment you see one. This is the game's one true missable: an early Chapter 1 spot disappears permanently once that chapter closes, and there is no mission replay or New Game+ to get it back. The guides disagree on the details (see SOURCES DISAGREE below), so the safe play is simple: meditate everywhere, immediately, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
trophies.how: Meditate at every spot the moment you see one; never walk past a spot.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.t: Meditate at every meditation spot the moment you see one — never walk past a spot.
Do the early Chapter 1 spot before the chapter closes; it is gone for good afterwards.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and use the stepper above to track your count to 18.

trophies.where: 18 spots in 10 locations across Leonida — starting with one early spot in Chapter 1.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is part of Stop 2's side-story cleanup, and his quests are one of the must-be-full sets for A Long Road — finish them properly rather than leaving one behind.
trophies.how: Take Bret's hunt and bring down the unique animal.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.t: Find Bret's hunt in the side-story strands.
Track the unique animal and take it down.
Bret's quests are a must-be-full set for A Long Road, so finish every one.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — collect them as you travel rather than leaving a dedicated sweep for the end, and check your set progress as you go so you know which set is closest to done.
trophies.how: Collect cards across Leonida until 3 full sets are complete.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.t: Pick up collectible cards whenever you pass one — they are scattered across Leonida.
Watch your set progress and focus on the set closest to complete.
The trophy pops when the third set is complete.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The photo-spot collection — find the marked locations across Leonida and snap each one. Like the other collections it is all doable in free roam after the story, so sweep it in Stop 4 with the cards, the vehicles and the 52 areas.
trophies.how: WAiNK It at 100 marked locations across Leonida.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.t: Find WAiNK It locations as you travel — they are marked across Leonida.
Snap each one; the count runs to 100.
Sweep the stragglers in free roam during Stop 4.

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges are the small tasks scattered through the game — the 100% checklist counts 70 of 80 as enough, so you can skip the hardest ones, but this trophy needs 50 done. Let them accumulate naturally, then mop up the easy remainder in Stop 6.
trophies.how: Finish 50 challenges; skip the hardest — 70 of 80 is enough for 100%.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.t: Do challenges as they come up during the story and side content.
In Stop 6, mop up the easy remainder — the hardest challenges can be skipped.
The trophy pops at 50 completed challenges.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Build heat with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search until the stars clear — the partner has to be with you when the heat drops.
trophies.how: Reach 4 stars with your partner, then lose the heat together.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.t: Get your partner with you, then build a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear.
The trophy pops when the heat drops with your partner still beside you.

trophies.where: Vice City — with your partner, at 4 stars.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a short route between three shops, hit them in quick succession, and keep the heat the whole way — losing the stars between shops breaks the chain.
trophies.how: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.t: Pick three shops close together and plan the route between them.
Rob them back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level.
The trophy pops after the third shop, while the heat is still on.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning vehicles as you travel counts toward both this trophy and the 100% checklist, which wants 200 of 277 — scan everything you pass in the story and the count takes care of itself.
trophies.how: Scan and discover 100 vehicles as you travel.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.t: Scan every new vehicle you pass — discovery counts on sight.
Keep the habit through the story; the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277.
The trophy pops at 100 discovered vehicles.

trophies.where: Mount Kalaga — vehicles anywhere in Leonida.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a moment with a group of enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends — a crowded fight is the right setup, not a duel.
trophies.how: Drop 5 enemies in one Combat Focus, in a crowded fight.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.t: Find a fight with a group of enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends.
The trophy pops on the fifth takedown inside one Focus.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. Take a plane out without a flight plan, in the game's own words an unscheduled departure. The VCIA Takedown mission introduces the airport; come back to it in Stop 5.
trophies.how: Leave VCIA by plane without a schedule — an unscheduled departure.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.t: Go to VCIA, the airport introduced in the VCIA Takedown mission.
Get a plane and make an unscheduled departure.
The trophy pops once you are airborne and away.

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. The description is a joke, not an instruction: the trophy is about the Rhino tanks, and the guides agree the moment involves taking one on. Come prepared and pick your ground in Stop 5.
trophies.how: Take on the Rhino tanks — come prepared, pick your ground.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.t: Find a Rhino tank in free roam during Stop 5.
Take it on with heavy weapons and cover — do not fight it in the open.
The trophy pops when the Rhino is dealt with.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the whole trophy — plan the approach, avoid cameras and sightlines, get in and out clean. One detection restarts the attempt, so save first if you are unsure.
trophies.how: Rob a jewelry store clean — no detection, no alarms.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.t: Pick a jewelry store and scout its sightlines and cameras first.
Rob it without being detected — one detection restarts the attempt.
The trophy pops once you are clear with the take.

trophies.where: Vice City — a jewelry store, scouted first.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults are the big scores of Stop 5 — plan each one, hit it, and get clear. Five vaults, five escapes; the count is cumulative, so you can spread them across the stop.
trophies.how: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.t: Find a bank vault and plan the approach and the escape route.
Rob it and get clear — the count is cumulative across all 5.
The trophy pops after the fifth escape.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes across Leonida — intercept one, take it, and get clear before the response arrives. One clean hit is all it takes.
trophies.how: Intercept an armored truck, rob it, and escape.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.t: Find an armored truck on its route in free roam.
Stop it and take the cargo.
Escape clean — the trophy pops once you are clear.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel — every region you visit counts, and the getaway route in this guide crosses all of them. Sweep the corners in Stop 4 if any area is still dark.
trophies.how: Visit all 52 areas; sweep the dark corners in Stop 4.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.t: Travel through every region — the map fills in as you visit each area.
Check the area count and sweep any region still dark.
The trophy pops at 52 of 52 areas explored.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang has operations to hit — work through the list gang by gang, and mind the warning in this guide about the Criminal Profile: an 'Irredeemable' rating is permanent, so do not go on a rampage beyond what the trophies need.
trophies.how: Rob one illegal operation per gang — all 9 gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.t: Find an illegal operation belonging to a gang you have not hit yet.
Rob it, then move to the next gang — 9 gangs in all.
Keep the hits surgical: a permanent 'Irredeemable' Criminal Profile is not worth extra chaos.

trophies.where: Mount Kalaga — illegal operations, gang by gang.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The name hints at an early moment, so do it as early as you can — but be honest about what is known: the exact trigger for this trophy is not yet confirmed in public guides, so this entry is labelled unconfirmed and says only what the description itself gives. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail with the view, and see if it pops.
trophies.how: Ocean Beach, early: a cocktail with the view. Trigger not yet confirmed.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.t: Go to Ocean Beach as early in the story as you can — the name hints at an early moment.
Order a cocktail with the view, as the description says.
Trigger not yet confirmed in public guides — if it does not pop, it is a watch item for the cleanup stop, not a failure.

trophies.where: Vice City — Ocean Beach, early in the story.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description is the whole instruction — but the exact trigger is not yet confirmed in public guides, so this entry is labelled unconfirmed and does not invent a method. A showroom, a vehicle, a classic-style exit: try it in Stop 7 and report what works.
trophies.how: A vehicle showroom, smashed out of in classic style. Trigger not yet confirmed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.t: Find a vehicle showroom in free roam during Stop 7.
Drive out through the showroom front in classic style, as the description says.
Trigger not yet confirmed in public guides — this one stays a watch item until the method is confirmed.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the named alley and finish a game — the follow-through is the point, so play it out rather than walking away mid-game.
trophies.how: Bowl a full game at the Kolt & Associates alley.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.t: Go to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
Bowl a full game and follow through to the end.
The trophy pops when the game is finished.

trophies.where: Vice City — the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description points at a partnership moment played for a crowd — Jason and Lucia together, somewhere people are watching. It sits with the misc moments because no single mission carries it, so work it in Stop 7's cleanup: play the partnership beats with both protagonists and look for the crowd moment.
trophies.how: A partnership moment, played for a crowd.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.t: Play the partnership beats with Jason and Lucia together in free roam after the story.
Look for a crowd moment — mass appeal means an audience is watching.
If it has not popped by the end of Stop 7, re-check the cited guides for a confirmed method.

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices. The counter is cumulative — every choice in dialogue and missions counts, and 500 is a grind, not a skill check. Play normally through the story and the count builds; mop up the remainder in Stop 6 by making choices wherever they appear.
trophies.how: Make choices wherever they appear — the count runs to 500.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.t: Make choices as they appear in dialogue and missions — the count is cumulative.
Play normally through the story; the total builds on its own.
In Stop 6, mop up the remainder wherever choices appear.

trophies.where: Statewide — choices in dialogue and missions.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description hints at succeeding on a second try — but the exact trigger is not yet confirmed in public guides, so this entry is labelled unconfirmed and does not invent a method. If something fails once and works on the retry, this is likely the moment; keep it on the watch list in Stop 7.
trophies.how: Succeed on a second try. Trigger not yet confirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.t: The description hints at a second try — the trigger is not yet confirmed in public guides.
If an attempt fails once and succeeds on the retry, note it; that is the likely moment.
Keep it on the watch list in Stop 7 rather than chasing an invented method.

trophies.where: Statewide — a second try that works.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description is a reaction, not an instruction — the trigger is not yet confirmed in public guides, so this entry is labelled unconfirmed. It reads like witnessing something strange out in the world; explore odd corners in Stop 4 and keep it on the watch list.
trophies.how: Witness something strange out in Leonida. Trigger not yet confirmed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.t: The description is a reaction, not an instruction — the trigger is not yet confirmed.
Explore strange and out-of-the-way places in Stop 4, especially the Grassrivers.
Keep it on the watch list; do not chase an invented method.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The trigger is not yet confirmed in public guides, so this entry is labelled unconfirmed — but the description is plain enough to try in Stop 3: a melee attack from a moving vehicle, bowling someone over. Try it at the bowling alley's neighbourhood and keep it on the watch list.
trophies.how: A melee drive-by that bowls someone over. Trigger not yet confirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.t: The trigger is not yet confirmed in public guides — the description is the best lead.
Try a melee attack from a moving vehicle that bowls someone over.
Keep it on the watch list in Stop 3 until the method is confirmed.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from the crime stops — launder them through contacts, $250,000 in total. It is a grind measured in dollars, so fold it into Stop 6 with the spending and the garages.
trophies.how: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.t: Collect Marked Bills from the crime stops — they are the input for this trophy.
Launder them through your contacts, a little at a time.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered in total.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The easiest grind in Stop 6 — buy what you need anyway (weapons, clothes, cars) and the total climbs. It pairs naturally with the garages and the laundering, since the same money flows through all three.
trophies.how: Spend $100,000 across all shops — buy what you need anyway.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.t: Spend across all shops — weapons, clothes, cars, anything.
Buy what you need anyway and the $100,000 climbs on its own.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent in total.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are the property grind of Stop 6 — each one needs money, so this pairs with the laundering and the spending. Buy them as the cash allows; the trophy pops on the eighth.
trophies.how: Buy all 8 garage properties as the cash allows.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.t: Find the garage properties for sale across Leonida.
Buy them as the cash allows — 8 in all.
The trophy pops when the eighth garage is yours.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, open the app, register them — ten registrations and the trophy is done. It pairs with the vehicle discovery of Stop 4, since the same cars count in both places.
trophies.how: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.t: Find a vehicle and open the Scooter Bros app.
Register it, then move to the next — 10 registrations in all.
The trophy pops on the tenth registration.

trophies.where: Vice City — the Scooter Bros app.
